author: Ankit
problem: Split the list into consecutive groups of size items (the last group may be shorter) and return the sum of each group.
bug_description: The loop runs to len(nums) - 1 instead of len(nums), so a last group with only one item is skipped.

comments.accurate: Returns the sum of each consecutive group of size items; the last group may be shorter
comments.wrong_behavior: Sums each group of size items; a single leftover item at the end is dropped
comments.wrong_location: Range bounds checked; the slice end may overrun on the final group
